_comment: A world held at the cold end, and the clearest case of a word meaning its own part of whatever it is
laid on (world model 3). Temperature is what makes an Age frozen at all and is the core; everything
else is what *this* frozen Age happens to be like, drawn from the pool.
It declares no aspects, so it reaches whatever its claims reach -- the climate, the air, the sky. That
is the whole of what attachment then does: `frozen climate` lands the temperature and nothing else,
`frozen sky` a pale vault and a small distant sun, and `a frozen Age` puts every one of them in play.
One word rather than four, and no rule anywhere had to say so.
The sun is at the bottom of its axis rather than below it, which is as small as a sun goes: `sunsize`
starts at vanilla's own and only grows (see Sky.sunSizeAt), because a small sun is a distant one and
